description: Jupiter quote + unsigned swap tx. `amount` in input-mint base units. Returns the unsigned tx + lastValidBlockHeight + quote details.

amount.description: Amount in base units as a decimal string (not a float). For a 6-decimal mint, "1000000" is 1 token.

inputMint.description: A Solana address in base58, 32-44 chars.

outputMint.description: A Solana address in base58, 32-44 chars.

taker.description: A Solana address in base58, 32-44 chars.

name: solknife_swap_order
